description: This file defines a CKEditor plugin dialog for selecting special characters, including UI setup, event handling, and character grid rendering.

methods.name: onChoice
methods.description: Handles selection of a special character, inserts it into the editor, and closes the dialog.

methods.name: onFocus
methods.description: Handles focus event on character elements, updates preview and highlights.

methods.name: onBlur
methods.description: Handles blur event, resets previews and removes highlight.

methods.name: onKeydown
methods.description: Handles keyboard navigation within the character grid, including arrow keys, space, and tab.
